import ctypes
import math

# Load the dynamic libraries in the correct order
libgslcblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the argument and return types for gsl_cdf_pareto_P
gsl.gsl_cdf_pareto_P.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_cdf_pareto_P.restype = ctypes.c_double

# Define the argument and return types for gsl_cdf_pareto_Q
gsl.gsl_cdf_pareto_Q.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_cdf_pareto_Q.restype = ctypes.c_double

def pareto_cdf_P(x, a, b):
    """Compute the CDF of the Pareto distribution."""
    return gsl.gsl_cdf_pareto_P(x, a, b)

def pareto_cdf_Q(x, a, b):
    """Compute the complementary CDF of the Pareto distribution."""
    return gsl.gsl_cdf_pareto_Q(x, a, b)

def assert_test():
    """Run test cases to validate the implementation."""
    # Test case 1: x < b
    x, a, b = 1.0, 2.0, 2.0
    assert math.isclose(pareto_cdf_P(x, a, b), 0.0, rel_tol=1e-9)
    assert math.isclose(pareto_cdf_Q(x, a, b), 1.0, rel_tol=1e-9)

    # Test case 2: x = b
    x, a, b = 2.0, 2.0, 2.0
    assert math.isclose(pareto_cdf_P(x, a, b), 0.0, rel_tol=1e-9)
    assert math.isclose(pareto_cdf_Q(x, a, b), 1.0, rel_tol=1e-9)

    # Test case 3: x > b
    x, a, b = 4.0, 2.0, 2.0
    expected_P = 1 - (b / x) ** a
    expected_Q = (b / x) ** a
    assert math.isclose(pareto_cdf_P(x, a, b), expected_P, rel_tol=1e-9)
    assert math.isclose(pareto_cdf_Q(x, a, b), expected_Q, rel_tol=1e-9)

    # Test case 4: Large values of x, a, b
    x, a, b = 100.0, 3.0, 10.0
    expected_P = 1 - (b / x) ** a
    expected_Q = (b / x) ** a
    assert math.isclose(pareto_cdf_P(x, a, b), expected_P, rel_tol=1e-9)
    assert math.isclose(pareto_cdf_Q(x, a, b), expected_Q, rel_tol=1e-9)

    print("All tests passed.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
